sections.heading: Institute of Hotel Management vs Servo Hospitality School for Hotel Management Diploma: which is better in 2026
paragraphs: Choose the Institute of Hotel Management, Dehradun, only after you have an official fee circular, because our table lists diploma programmes in food production and food and beverages services but has no fee or placement row.
Choose Servo Hospitality School if the recorded International Diploma in Hotel Management, with a Total Fees year figure of ₹1.25 lakh, is the course you want, after you confirm the official notice.

sections.heading: Fees: what our records show, and what to watch
paragraphs: For the Institute of Hotel Management, Dehradun, we hold no fee row on this page. Do not invent a diploma fee, and do not copy a figure from another IHM campus.
For Servo Hospitality School we hold ₹1.25 lakh as a Total Fees year figure for the International Diploma in Hotel Management. That is a year figure, not a confirmed official programme total.
Confirm the current notices on the official IHM Dehradun and Servo sites before you budget, including hostel or international-module charges if any.

sections.heading: Placements compared
paragraphs: Neither college has a placement row on this page.
Ask both campuses for an official training or placement note if hotel internships or campus offers are central to your decision.

sections.heading: Admission, ranks and eligibility
paragraphs: No entrance exam is mapped on this page. Follow each institute's official diploma admissions process.
Our table has no ranking rows for either college in this comparison.

sections.heading: Location and campus
paragraphs: Both are recorded in Dehradun, Uttarakhand, so a local student can visit them on the same day.
The listed diplomas are not automatically the same qualification. Match the exact diploma name, duration and industry training, not only the city.

sections.heading: Verdict: who should pick which college
paragraphs: Pick the Institute of Hotel Management, Dehradun, only if that campus and diploma are the offer you want, after you have a written official fee.
Pick Servo Hospitality School if the international diploma and the recorded ₹1.25 lakh year fee are acceptable, after official confirmation.
This page has no placement or rank data to break the tie. A campus visit and the official prospectus matter more than our empty rows.
